description: Search the New Hampshire RSA BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed weapon permit", "capital murder". Matches against the General Court's own official section and chapter CATCHLINES across the whole RSA (not full statutory prose — New Hampshire does not publish a full-text search of RSA section text, verified live). "landlord"/"tenant"/"lessor"/"lessee" are expanded to their statutory counterpart (NH's own catchlines name the landlord-tenant relationship by "tenant" almost exclusively, e.g. "Actions Against Tenants", even for chapters squarely about landlord obligations like security deposits), returned in `expanded_terms` when it fires. Returns matching citations and catchlines; call nh_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

name: nh_search
title: Nh Search
